stem.text: A cell of electromotive force (e.m.f.) $3.0\,\text{V}$ and internal resistance $0.50\,\Omega$ is connected to a variable resistor, a voltmeter and an ammeter, as shown. The resistance of the variable resistor is varied.
The reading on the ammeter $I$ and the reading on the voltmeter $V$ are recorded.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram with a cell in a dashed box labelled 3.0 V and 0.50 Ω, connected in series with an ammeter labelled A. A voltmeter labelled V is connected across a variable resistor, shown with an arrow through it.

stem.text: Which graph shows how $V$ varies with $I$?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled V / V, marked 0 and 0.50, and horizontal axis labelled I / A, marked 0 and 6.0. A straight line falls from the top of the vertical axis to the end of the horizontal axis.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled V / V, marked 0 and 3.0, and horizontal axis labelled I / A, marked 0 and 0.5. A straight line falls from the top of the vertical axis to the end of the horizontal axis.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled V / V, marked 0 and 3.0, and horizontal axis labelled I / A, marked 0 and 6.0. A straight line falls from the top of the vertical axis to the end of the horizontal axis.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled V / V, marked 0 and 6.0, and horizontal axis labelled I / A, marked 0 and 3.0. A straight line falls from the top of the vertical axis to the end of the horizontal axis.
